shipped_rows.title_o: Effectiveness of an early reading intervention in a semi-transparent orthography: A group randomised controlled trial

blind_target.evidence_quote: The On Track program, previously found to be effective in a researcher-driven and tightly controlled setting, was implemented in a larger sample of schools. To investigate the robustness of the original findings, specific aspects of the implementation were deliberately altered from the original study.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Results indicated that the intervention significantly reduced the number of at-risk students by the end of first grade. However, effect sizes in the replication study were reduced compared to the original try-out.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Abstract states original program effective and corresponding beneficial intervention result, explicitly compares reduced sizes; reduced magnitude alone is not mixed. Reference citation is not in the abstract.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract directly compares the larger On Track implementation with an original try-out, but neither its author/title/citation nor the supplied row's equivalence to that try-out is established by this abstract. The supplied shipped original is an early reading intervention paper and may be the original; full citation context or an adjudication establishing identity is needed. The listed adjudication file is absent.
